entities.name: Sewing Machine
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Elias Howe and Isaac Singer developed commercial sewing machines that could stitch 250 stitches per minute — 5x a skilled hand sewer. Singer's installment payment plan made it the first affordable consumer machine.
